KPI_1.name: M1 Opportunities Created Count for Non-Closed Won Deals
KPI_1.description: Tracks the count of M1 stage opportunities created, excluding closed won deals with positive ACV for both new and existing customers.

KPI_2.name: M1 Starting ACV for Non-Closed Won Deals
KPI_2.description: Measures the total starting Annual Contract Value for M1 stage opportunities, excluding closed won deals for both customer types.

KPI_3.name: S0 Opportunities Created Count for Non-Closed Won Deals
KPI_3.description: Tracks the count of S0 stage opportunities created, excluding closed won deals with positive ACV for both new and existing customers.

KPI_4.name: S0 Starting ACV for Non-Closed Won Deals
KPI_4.description: Measures the total starting Annual Contract Value for S0 stage opportunities, excluding closed won deals for both customer types.

KPI_5.name: S1 Opportunities Created Count for Non-Closed Won Deals
KPI_5.description: Tracks the count of S1 stage opportunities created, excluding closed won deals with positive ACV for both new and existing customers.

KPI_6.name: S1 Starting ACV for Non-Closed Won Deals
KPI_6.description: Measures the total starting Annual Contract Value for S1 stage opportunities, excluding closed won deals for both customer types.

KPI_7.name: S1 Opportunities Created Count by Team (Non-Null)
KPI_7.description: Tracks S1 opportunity creation count by team, excluding closed won deals and null team values for both customer types.

KPI_8.name: S0 Starting ACV by Team (Non-Null)
KPI_8.description: Measures S0 starting ACV by team, excluding closed won deals and null team values for both customer types.

KPI_9.name: M1 Opportunities Created Count by Team (Non-Null)
KPI_9.description: Tracks M1 opportunity creation count by team, excluding closed won deals and null team values for both customer types.

KPI_10.name: Total Opportunity ACV for Active Deals
KPI_10.description: Measures total Annual Contract Value for active opportunities with positive ACV, excluding closed won deals for both customer types.

attributes: Opportunity Stage, Opportunity Type, Opportunity Creator Profile, Opportunity Source Detailed, Opportunity Owner Name
goal: Track sales opportunity creation and progression across different stages (M1, S0, S1) to monitor pipeline generation performance and team productivity.
user_context: Sales managers and revenue operations leaders use this dashboard during weekly and monthly pipeline reviews to track opportunity creation across different sales stages (M1, S0, S1) by analyzing both deal count and ACV metrics, comparing individual contributor performance against team benchmarks, identifying which lead sources are most productive, examining opportunity progression through the sales funnel while filtering out closed-won deals, and drilling down from high-level KPIs to detailed breakdowns by creator profiles, teams, and sources to make data-driven decisions about resource allocation and process improvements.
